title: Term-minimal realizations of nine line-type configurations in quadratic mass-action systems
description: Article draft v1 and a certificate package. In two-species quadratic mass-action systems with reactant molecularity at most two, unrestricted products, a positive equilibrium with zero Jacobian, and nonzero homogeneous resultant, nine invariant-line-type multisets have minimum component-term counts 8,8,8,8,8,8,8,6,6. The package includes exact witnesses, a support-based lower-bound proof, and standard-library checkers from two implementations. The question comes from Yeung and Erban, with geometric foundations in Lyagina and Newton. Reaction counts are not minimized; historical full-text domain comparison and broader priority review remain incomplete. No priority, proof-assistant assurance or human peer review is claimed.
